JUDGMENT
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NOS.11201-11202 OF 2011 
BASHISTH NARAYAN SINGH                            APPELLANT
                 VERSUS
PUNJAB NATIONAL BANK & ANR.                       RESPONDENTS
O R D E R
1.
Application for permission to appear and argue in-person 
is allowed.
2.
Delay in filing the appeals is condoned.
3.
We have heard the appellant-in-person and also the learned 
counsel for the respondents.
4.
Having perused the records and in view of the facts and 
circumstances of the case,   we are of the opinion that the civil 
appeals, being devoid of any merit, deserves to be dismissed and 
are dismissed accordingly.
.......................J.
(H.L. DATTU)
.......................J.
(JAGDISH SINGH KHEHAR)
NEW DELHI;
MAY 02, 2013
